answer: Plant canary tasks: the ledger quietly mixes answers with a known correct grade into every grader's queue, like a reef hidden under a calm ocean. Graders who rubber-stamp a sybil ring's work also miss the canaries, so their weight drops and their bond is cut. To earn, every fake must actually read and judge each item, so an attacker pays real compute per identity and can't bridge cheap clones into trusted seats.
